svg.title: PawLocal operations and CI/CD architecture
svg.desc: Ordinary owner-approved changes and mode-dependent incident automation share immutable development and production releases, with separate Terraform states and recovery assessment.

g.text: Evidence and policy limits remain separate
Publish immutable backend image to GHCR
Bind release source commit and image digest
Trusted publication / release jobs: scoped credentials
Verify served release, API and database
Same source commit + backend image digest
Select the DEV-verified source and image
Publish; verify served release, API and database
OBSERVABILITY & INCIDENT RESPONSE / SEPARATE RUNTIME BOUNDARIES
A green deploy is not recovery acceptance
DEC-017: incident software review, provenance, budget, stop and recovery checks can be skipped. External GitHub / IAM controls remain.
DEC-015: strict release-only validator is off. Models remain isolated before merge; merged operational code may run in credential-bearing release jobs.
Operator runbooks: investigate · emergency stop · recovery review | No new infrastructure approval implied
